name: Chayan Yuese tea bag gift set
where: Chayan Yuese (Hunan local tea brand) official goods and tea shops
about: A tea brand from Hunan, known in Changsha. Its gift sets are sealed tea bags, not ready-to-drink drinks, so they travel well.
tip: Choose a sealed box rather than a ready-to-drink product, since sealed tea is easier to pack and carry home.

name: Xiang embroidery small item
where: Sales counter at the Hunan Xiang Embroidery Museum
about: Hunan's traditional embroidery craft. Each piece is stitched by hand, which sets it apart from printed imitations.
tip: Check that the stitching is visible on the surface, not printed, to be sure you are buying real embroidery.
